name: HIAC Zoo-Mesh Mode Parallelism
definition: A parallel volume rendering method for arbitrary polyhedra (zoo elements) using work quanta for load balancing. The sort thread distributes work quanta to projection threads, which store results in arrays within the quantum, and the render thread polls for completion.
summary: HIAC Zoo-Mesh Mode Parallelism is a parallel volume rendering method for arbitrary polyhedra that reduces triangle counts by avoiding tetrahedral decomposition, differing from its parent method by supporting general cell geometry.
